RedShelf contains open-source components:

- xhshow-ts 1.2.0, MIT; xhshow-ts-LICENSE.txt
  https://github.com/ikenxuan/xhshow-ts
- @jspm/core 2.1.0 and bundled browser shims; jspm-core-LICENSE.txt
  https://github.com/jspm/jspm-core
- xiaohongshu-cli xhssign, Apache-2.0; xiaohongshu-cli-LICENSE.txt
  https://github.com/tamnd/xiaohongshu-cli
- Go mobile bindings, BSD-3-Clause; gomobile-LICENSE.txt
  https://github.com/netbirdio/gomobile-tvos-fork

These packages are unofficial and are not affiliated with Xiaohongshu.
